# PrintNPack

> PrintNPack prints custom banners, banner stands and napkins in Ashbourne, Co. Meath, Ireland, and ships them inside the EU, including France, Germany and Spain. Postage is quoted with the order. Order pages are in English. Customers may write the brief in French, German or Spanish; replies are in English.

PrintNPack, Unit 14 Ashbourne Business Centre, Ashbourne, Co. Meath, A84 KV57, Ireland.
Phone: +353 89 415 7369
Email: info@printnpack.ie
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/353894400155

Prices below are product prices in euro, not delivered prices. EU postage is extra. Standard print time is 3–5 working days after artwork approval.

## Banners, all types

PVC banners from €25, from 1 piece. 510 gsm PVC with hem and eyelets for outdoor use. Mesh PVC for windy fences. Roll-up banners from €80 including the cassette. Artwork-only reprints from €35. Extra-wide roll-ups, fabric stands, curved stands, pop-up walls from €489.30 ex VAT, stage backdrops up to 50 m, table covers and flags are part of the same range.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/banners-ireland): Banner printing Ireland
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/impression-banderoles): Impression de banderoles pour la France
- [Deutsch](https://www.printnpack.ie/de/bannerdruck): Bannerdruck für Deutschland
- [Español](https://www.printnpack.ie/es/impresion-banderolas): Impresión de banderolas para España

## XXL banners

Indoor roll-up, 200 cm wide, Airtex 330, B1 fire rating, Silver XL stand and carry bag included. UV print, single sided. From 1 piece. Not for outdoor use.

- XL 200 × 200 cm: €398.96
- XXL 200 × 250 cm: €418.49
- XXXL 200 × 300 cm: €450

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/extra-wide-roll-up-banners-ireland): Extra wide roll up banners

- [Español](https://www.printnpack.ie/es/banderolas-xxl): Roll up XXL de 2 metros

## Banners with stands

A banner with a stand is a graphic on a structure: straight aluminium tension-fabric frame, curved frame, pop-up wall, or a roll-up whose cassette is the stand. It is not an eyelet PVC banner. Straight frames: 250 × 228 cm, 300 × 230 cm, 400 × 230 cm, 500 × 230 cm, 600 × 230 cm. Complete kit or replacement graphic only. Curved frames about 3–5 m. Pop-up walls from €489.30 ex VAT. Roll-up with cassette from €80.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/fabric-banner-stands-ireland): Fabric banner stands
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/banderoles-avec-support): Banderoles avec support
- [Deutsch](https://www.printnpack.ie/de/banner-mit-gestell): Banner mit Gestell
- [Español](https://www.printnpack.ie/es/banderolas-con-soporte): Banderolas con soporte

## Napkins, all types

Cocktail napkins: white, 10 × 10 cm closed, 20 × 40 cm open, from 50. Printed paper napkins from about €0.05, usually from 1,000. Airlaid linen-feel from about €0.10, usually from 1,000. Plain wholesale napkins from about €0.03 per case. Lunch size 33 cm. Dinner size 40 cm. Wedding names, dates and kraft napkins are available. Printed in Ireland and shipped to France, Germany and Spain with postage quoted.

- [English](https://www.printnpack.ie/napkins-ireland): Napkins Ireland
- [Français](https://www.printnpack.ie/fr/serviettes-personnalisees): Serviettes personnalisées
